title: Prospective review of Vancomycin Resistance among Enterococcus faecalis in a tertiary care teaching hospital
author: Soniya T
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Collect clinical isolates
steps.instruction: Collect non‑repetitive, consecutive clinically significant Enterococcus faecalis isolates (total n = 124) from the teaching hospital during the period January 2020 – July 2021.

steps.title: Identify species
steps.instruction: Identify each isolate to the species level as Enterococcus faecalis using standard conventional microbiological methods.

steps.title: Disc diffusion susceptibility
steps.instruction: Test susceptibility of each isolate to a panel of antibiotics, including vancomycin and teicoplanin, by the disc diffusion method according to standard guidelines.

steps.title: Determine vancomycin MIC
steps.instruction: Determine the minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of vancomycin for each isolate using the agar dilution method.

steps.title: PCR detection of van genes
steps.instruction: Perform polymerase chain reaction (PCR) on DNA extracted from all 124 isolates to detect the presence of vanA and vanB genes.
